aiOverview.content: Beauty in Black Season 2 Part 2 premiered on Netflix on March 19, 2026, bringing new episodes filled with intensified drama as Kimmie navigates her role within the Bellarie empire. All new episodes in this installment were released at once. Key Details About New Episodes Release Date: All episodes of Season 2, Part 2 arrived on March 19, 2026. Platform: Exclusively streaming on Netflix. Plotline: The new episodes focus on Kimmie's (Taylor Polidore Williams) rise to power, managing the Bellarie hair care empire, and her confrontations with Mallory (Crystle Stewart). Upcoming Future: The series has already been renewed for a third and final season [8, Netflix].
